notes: All 20 clubs were checked through the Penn Clubs directory API (20 fetches), and 9 club websites were read (9 fetches). Searches used: 0. No pages were blocked. Verdicts: 20 publish, 0 hide, 0 duplicate. Eleven records are ready to go live with status probably_active or active: Nepali Student Association, Netter Center Student Advisory Board, Neuroscience Society, Nursing and Healthcare Management, Nursing Students for Global Health, Nutrition and Advocacy Partners, Off The Beat, Outdoors Club, Pan-Asian Dance Troupe, Paraguayans at Penn, and Pediatric Childhood Cancer Coalition. Nine records are held back with status unknown and no summary, because the directory status reads INACTIVE while the active flag is true: Neurotech, Nigerians at Penn, NEST, OSO Penn, Onda Latina, Onyx, PAGSA, Pen to Paper, and PAGE. Most directory entries have empty events lists, so few clubs have dated evidence. Only Pan-Asian Dance Troupe has a dated item (fall 2026 auditions listed for August 30 and 31, 2026), which makes it the only active status. The Netter Center and NHCM student boards are appointed and not accepting members: they are published with newcomer friendliness 1 and open_to invite, and the owner may prefer to hide them as private. Personal-looking emails were not recorded (OSO Penn, the Paraguayans officer, and the Off The Beat advisor). Several entries show UNDER REVIEW or PRELIMINARY status with active and approved set to true; these were treated as active listings with no dated item, which is probably_active. The PAGSA site mentions Campaign for Working Families as a volunteer opportunity with no link, so it was not added to leads_only.
